subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Should this Control UI progress strip be implemented only after the broader gateway sessions.activity/statechange contract is accepted or narrowed?
rationale: The requested UI depends on public session activity semantics across active runs, subagents, tool waits, terminal delivery, and reconnects; automation should not choose that API shape while the canonical issue and candidate PRs remain open.

options.title: Base UI on gateway activity
options.body: Adopt or narrow the sessions.activity/statechange direction, then implement the compact Control UI strip from that contract.

options.title: Allow a UI-local strip first
options.body: Permit a smaller Control UI implementation using existing local signals, accepting possible replacement when the gateway contract lands.

options.title: Defer to candidate PR review
options.body: Keep this issue as UX acceptance criteria while maintainers decide whether the open session activity/status PRs should own the implementation path.

recommendation.title: Base UI on gateway activity
recommendation.body: Adopt or narrow the sessions.activity/statechange direction, then implement the compact Control UI strip from that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the broader gateway activity issue and appears in current blame for the existing session/status surfaces.
